_readme: S443 (SkyToyon): how Foothill's CourseLeaf program pages print a program's A.A. and its certificate on one page. 73 of Foothill's 190 programs with a course list read no page (page_claimed, capture 38675242638): the page went to the certificate and the A.A. lost it. The reader's section-heading rule (section_award) found no line naming the award and the title together on a capture-only read (run 39654813908), so this read prints the headings and tab labels as the page prints them.

questions.award_sections: Where does the page name each award (A.A., A.S., Certificate of Achievement): a heading line, a tab label, or text?
